تشيطنت (form IIq)
# تَشَيْطَنْتُ (tašayṭantu) /ta.ʃaj.tˤan.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# تَشَيْطَنْتَ (tašayṭanta) /ta.ʃaj.tˤan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# تَشَيْطَنْتِ (tašayṭanti) /ta.ʃaj.tˤan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# تَشَيْطَنَتْ (tašayṭanat) /ta.ʃaj.tˤa.nat
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
